description: Radars routiers dans le Gard is a dataset listed in data.nimes-metropole open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Ministère de l'Intérieur, Antoine Augusti. Emplacement des radars fixe dans le département du Gard. Coverage: Nîmes Métropole. The portal files it under Transports et Mobilité. Its keywords are radar, France, sécurité routière, Vitesse. The portal shows 60 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2020-06-04 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open License v2.0 (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2018/11/open-licence.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-nimes-metropole-fr-portal.
